assessment.why: Original bottle placement gives Justin a physical connection, but the lethal carrier was an anonymous favor miniature; fragment holder and dosing time are not identified.

plausibility_notes: An empty-looking glass may contain a small cyanide dose or residue, later dissolved by punch. Contaminated miniature suggests decanting from original; fragment in favor paper may identify who did it once provenance is known.
